description.value: True Grain is an organic craft bakery that has operated in the seaside village of Cowichan Bay since 2004, stone-milling its own heritage and ancient grains grown on BC organic farms. Every loaf, pastry, and cookie is made by hand using European-inspired recipes with no additives or preservatives. For a touring cyclist, it offers a rare chance to pick up freshly milled flour alongside genuinely artisan sourdough bread and baked goods in a scenic destination village.

address.value: 1725 Cowichan Bay Road, Cowichan Bay, V0R 1N0
